# muse-avatar-prompts-that-pass

> Muse avatar prompts that pass — concrete, policy-safe briefs that stop refusals.

Avatar Prompt Polish rewrites a raw Muse avatar request into a concrete, policy-safe brief — a specific character, outfit and setting in plain language, with no weapon, no real person and no trademarked character — so Muse's avatar service accepts it instead of refusing it.
